images.title: Mixing regular coffee: 15 : 35 is 3 : 7
images.purpose: Shows the ratio mixer in its simplest state: 15 mL of decoction and 35 mL of milk poured into one cup, with the ratio and its simplest form.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two jugs on the left and right pour into one cup in the centre; the ratio is written under the cup.
images.exact_structure: Left: one jug filled amber (#E69F00), labelled decoction 15 mL under it. Right: one jug filled white with a grey (#6B7280) outline, labelled milk 35 mL under it. Exactly two curved pour arrows, one from each jug, point into one cup in the centre. The cup is filled with a pale amber tint. Under the cup, large: 15 : 35; under that, an arrow down to 3 : 7. A small reddish purple (#CC79A7) tag beside the cup reads regular. Nothing else in the frame.
